transcript_tail.text: `prod_to_dev.sql` is still **tracked** on main (the gitignore entry is just a guard against re-adding a PII-laden copy; tracked files aren't ignored), so #79's rewrite of it is committable — no conflict there. No live session or claim owns the work. I'll fork it into this worktree (which sits at current main HEAD, newer than its `77b3ed8e` base) and check it still applies cleanly.

The `--check` "does not match index" is expected (the patch's base blobs differ from main's); 3-way will reconcile via the shared object store. Let me first see which of the 9 files main actually changed since `77b3ed8e`, so I know where conflicts could arise, then do the real 3-way apply.

Code changes look clean — the fallback-list resolver works on both an anonymized dev DB and a fresh prod dump. Now the big one: the SQL rewrite. Let me read the full new `prod_to_dev.sql`.

I've reviewed the whole change set. Here's what I found.

## Why your login failed

You logged into `localhost:3001/login` with **`admin@dev.familyfund.local`** — and the running dev DB has no such user, so Laravel returned *"These credentials do not match our records."*

That email isn't arbitrary: it's the **target admin identity introduced by the very work you're asking me to resume (#79)**, which hasn't been applied to the running database yet. Current state vs. the #79 end-state:

| | Current running DB (localhost:3001) | After #79's `prod_to_dev.sql` runs |
|---|---|---|
| Admin email | `jdtogni@gmail.com` | `admin@dev.familyfund.local` |
| Admin password | original restored hash | `devpassword123` |
| Other users | `user{id}@dev.familyfund.local` | same |

So you typed the *future* admin email against a DB that still has the *old* one. Two ways to log in **right now**:
- `http://localhost:3001/dev-login/dashboard?as=admin` (the alias still resolves to `jdtogni@gmail.com` on the current DB), or
- the normal form with `jdtogni@gmail.com` and the admin password.

## The work to resume — it's ticket #79

"Ticket creation, SQL migration, PII removal" = **issue #79: *harden `prod_to_dev.sql` — rotate ALL passwords + scrub ALL PII tables***. A prior session implemented and validated it (on testpool `test0`) but **never committed** — the changes were orphaned, uncommitted, in worktree `01XrHWMP` (based on the older `77b3ed8e`).

I've **forked those changes into this worktree** (cleanly — main hadn't touched any of the 9 files). Reviewed, it's solid and complete:
- `prod_to_dev.sql` fully rewritten — rotates *every* password (drops the real-hash restore), scrubs `persons`/`addresses`/`phones`/`iddocuments`, accounts, free-text notes, logs/sessions/tokens, with a guarded section 7 for newer tables; renames admin → `admin@dev.familyfund.local` / `Dev Admin`.
- Dev-login resolver (`routes/web.php`), `SecurityDevTokenCommand`, `FundTrait::isAdmin`, blades, `restore_dev_funds.sql`, `bin/prod-to-dev.sh` header — all updated with the `[admin@dev.familyfund.local, jdtogni@gmail.com]` fallback so it works on an anonymized DB *and* a fresh prod dump / test baseline.

Remaining: commit → (optionally re-validate) → merge to main → close #79. How do you want to proceed?
